title: Custom eggless cakes for Rosehill and Camellia families — pickup till 10pm
summary:
Most Western Sydney bakeries close by 6pm. That's a problem if you work in Parramatta and don't reach Rosehill or Camellia until after dark.

Harris Park stays open until 10pm, every day. Order a custom eggless cake — any design, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango, buttercream or fondant — and collect it after work, not on your lunch break.

100% eggless. Not some cakes. Every cake, every time — which is why Jain and vegetarian families near Rosehill and Camellia order here without asking first.

48 hours minimum. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
